decision: Retire automatic native Coauthors-to-numbered-author activation. Preserve the consumed deprecated field and its structured-person/publication relationship. An active deprecated alias is not an empty metadata slot.

nativeCodeFacts.Coauthors: A separate native display string with aliases coautor/coautores/coauthor/coauthors.
nativeCodeFacts.structuredAuthorSource: Native structured a is built separately. Coauthors is appended to displayed Authors later.
nativeCodeFacts.COinS: Structured a, or structured contributors c when present, provides COinS Authors. Coauthors does not provide that list.
nativeCodeFacts.Harvard: CITEREF uses up to four structured contributor/author/editor Last values and the year. Coauthors is absent from that selection.
nativeCodeFacts.omittedReference: Native mode cs2 defaults an unset ref to harv, so looking only for an explicit ref=harv is insufficient.

guardBoundary.binding: Exact native family and revision, complete canonical role/value set, Coauthors and structured people separately, all publication/date/title/URL/identifier/unknown fields and unequal-alias/blank precedence.
guardBoundary.comparisonView: Only source-proved nonperson repairs may normalize the comparison view. People normalization is disabled.
guardBoundary.writerBoundary: People list/link/tail rewriting in the same coauthor-bearing native call remains quiet; other field repairs in that call and person repairs in separate native calls remain independently enabled.
guardBoundary.foreignBoundary: Foreign source-role migrations have separate donor contracts. This native preservation rule does not authorize or globally disable them.

expectedAssertionAmendments.citation_people_cases.cjs: Four original coauthor-safe alias cases keep the same original source as the expected endpoint. Initial executed receipts are retained.
expectedAssertionAmendments.source_month_year_cases.cjs: The original Month+Year composition case still repairs the date but keeps its native coautor field.

countsAreSeparate.reason: The original coauthor predecessor rows were already classified as preserved or unsafe. The additional helper positives are explicitly superseded by the native preservation contract.

privateV2Supplement.protectionOnlyCandidate: Literal coautor/coauthor and unresolved key syntax candidates grant no author-writing authority. Actual native Coauthors role and source family are required for metadata obligations.
privateV2Supplement.unsupportedKeys: Control/NBSP/DEL/C1/PUA/comment/dynamic key shapes are quiet producer refusals, not newly accepted native aliases. Exact unmapped key bytes are retained by both legacy citation reconstructions.
privateV2Supplement.originalEvidenceRetained: The v1 cheap-gate counterexample and all prior assertion failures remain immutable.
